metadata.name: [SRE] OpenSearch index writes blocked
metadata.description: P1 OpenSearch ClusterIndexWritesBlocked > 0 for 15m (flood-stage / write block).

breach.query:
FROM metrics-aws.cloudwatch_metrics-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE aws.cloudwatch.namespace == "AWS/ES" AND aws.dimensions.NodeId IS NULL
| STATS blocked = MAX(aws.es.metrics.ClusterIndexWritesBlocked.max)
    BY aws.dimensions.DomainName, cloud.account.id, cloud.region
| WHERE blocked > 0
| KEEP aws.dimensions.DomainName, cloud.account.id, cloud.region, blocked
